findings.description: The KMS key used to protect audit trail data does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Audit log encryption keys are long-lived and without annual rotation a single compromised key material exposes the full history of audit data.

No explicit key policy is attached, so AWS applies the default policy granting the account root full kms:* access, which in turn allows any IAM principal in the account with matching IAM permissions to use or administer the key. For a key protecting audit trails this removes the separation of duties that would prevent an attacker with broad IAM rights from decrypting or scheduling deletion of audit data.
